title: 2026 UK GHG accounting-basis, boundary and revision controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025

facts.source_fact: Territorial emissions cover emissions occurring within UK borders.
facts.expected_handling: Tag records as territorial before comparison or aggregation.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates include activities of businesses in the UK regardless of where the business is registered.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer accounting basis from company registration.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates include activities of UK residents and visitors while in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Keep visitor activity in territorial scope when it occurs in the UK.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates include emissions and removals from UK land including forests and crop or grazing land.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve land and removal components in territorial totals.

facts.source_fact: Territorial headline estimates currently exclude international aviation and shipping.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge international aviation/shipping into headline territorial totals without an explicit series.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates exclude UK residents and UK-registered businesses abroad.
facts.expected_handling: Do not import overseas resident/business activity into territorial records.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates exclude overseas production of goods and services imported into the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat embedded import emissions as territorial emissions.

facts.source_fact: Territorial estimates exclude biogenic-origin CO2 from combustion to avoid double counting where carbon-stock change is reported in land use.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the biogenic CO2 accounting rule before summing sectors.

facts.source_fact: Residence emissions cover UK residents and UK-registered businesses whether emissions occur in the UK or overseas.
facts.expected_handling: Tag overseas emissions from UK residents/businesses as residence, not territorial.

facts.source_fact: Residence emissions include aviation and shipping from British operators or carriers.
facts.expected_handling: Keep operator-residency logic distinct from territorial aviation/shipping treatment.

facts.source_fact: Residence emissions include UK tourists abroad.
facts.expected_handling: Do not exclude overseas tourist emissions solely because they occur outside UK borders.

facts.source_fact: Residence emissions exclude foreign tourists in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat all activity physically inside the UK as residence emissions.

facts.source_fact: ONS describes residence emissions as covering Scope 1 direct emissions from owned or directly controlled sources.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label residence totals as full Scope 1+2+3 footprint.

facts.source_fact: Footprint emissions cover the supply-chain emissions of goods and services consumed in the UK wherever produced.
facts.expected_handling: Tag consumption-basis records as footprint and preserve supply-chain scope.

facts.source_fact: Footprint emissions include emissions embedded in imports and exclude emissions from UK-produced goods exported for consumption abroad.
facts.expected_handling: Use consumption destination rather than production location for footprint inclusion.

facts.source_fact: ONS describes footprint emissions as covering Scopes 1, 2 and 3.
facts.expected_handling: Do not compare footprint totals with Scope-1-only records without a scope warning.

facts.source_fact: Footprint estimates are published annually with a three-year lag; 2023 estimates were published in 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Carry reference-year and publication-year fields separately.

facts.source_fact: ONS states all three measures are reported using AR5 global warming potentials aligned with the latest agreed international reporting practice.
facts.expected_handling: Require compatible GWP basis before cross-series comparison.

facts.source_fact: Previous-year estimates across the measures can be revised because of underlying-data revisions or methodological improvements.
facts.expected_handling: Mark historical values as revision-prone rather than immutable.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ 2025 territorial emissions are provisional and subject to revision when final 2025 estimates are published in February 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label 2025 provisional values as final or freeze them as canonical final values.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable accounting/scheme boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference year, publication/update date and provisional/final status where applicable.
Carry source URL, publisher and method/provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert this document/method rule into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
